entry.title: [org.springframework.data:spring-data-mongodb] Spring Data MongoDB is vulnerable to SpEL (Spring Expression Language) expression injection
entry.content:
Spring Data MongoDB contains a SpEL (Spring Expression Language) expression injection vulnerability. The issue occurs during parameter binding when a user-defined repository query method is annotated with @Query and utilizes a capture-all placeholder.

Affected versions: Spring Data MongoDB 5.0.0 through 5.0.5; 4.5.0 through 4.5.11; 4.4.0 through 4.4.14; 4.3.0 through 4.3.16; 4.2.0 through 4.2.15; 4.1.0 through 4.1.14; 4.0.0 through 4.0.15; 3.4.0 through 3.4.19.

References

  • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-41717
  • https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41717
  • https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-data-mongodb/releases/tag/4.5.12
  • https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-data-mongodb/releases/tag/5.0.6
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-5whc-4q84-fj73

entry.title: [org.springframework.data:spring-data-keyvalue] Spring Data KeyValue: Remote code execution via SpEL Injection in Sort-based repository queries
entry.content:
A SpEL Injection vulnerability exists in the Spring Data KeyValue if unsanitized user input is passed as Sort into a repository query method that delegates evaluation to the SpelPropertyComparator.

Affected versions: Spring Data KeyValue / Spring Data Redis 4.0.0 through 4.0.5; 3.5.0 through 3.5.11; 3.4.0 through 3.4.14; 3.3.0 through 3.3.16; 3.2.0 through 3.2.15; 3.1.0 through 3.1.14; 3.0.0 through 3.0.15; 2.7.0 through 2.7.19.

entry.title: [org.springframework.security:spring-security-saml2-service-provider] Spring Security SAML2 Service Provider: Unbounded writer inflates the compressed SAML payload into memory (DoS)
entry.content:
An application using spring-security-saml2-service-provider and the REDIRECT binding for SAML 2.0 Login or Logout may be vulnerable to a denial of service by way of an unbounded writer that inflates the compressed SAML payload into memory.

Affected versions: Spring Security 5.7.0 through 5.7.23; 5.8.0 through 5.8.25; 6.3.0 through 6.3.16; 6.4.0 through 6.4.16; 6.5.0 through 6.5.10; 7.0.0 through 7.0.5.

entry.title: [org.springframework.restdocs:spring-restdocs-restassured] Spring REST Docs REST Assured & WebFlux are vulnerable to Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference
entry.content:
When using spring-restdocs-webtestclient or spring-restdocs-restassured to document a remote API accessed over HTTP, an attacker who compromises the API or tricks the user into documenting a malicious API can perform an XXE injection attack when the documentation-generating tests are next executed.

Affected versions: Spring REST Docs 4.0.0; 3.0.0 through 3.0.5; 2.0.0.RELEASE through 2.0.8.RELEASE.

References

  • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-40991
  • https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-40991
  • https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-restdocs/releases/tag/v3.0.6
  • https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-restdocs/releases/tag/v4.0.1
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6rpq-6vv2-5222
